evidence.why: All six countdown updates, effect outputs and shared scale assignments.

facts.rationale: Corrects five to six interval counters and records the useful distinction between independent timer checks and their shared cumulative scale variable.
facts.value: Reads the direction-change latch and active-emission gate, Lizardon interval attributes, dynamic bones 0x31/0x32 and item scale. It updates the direction bit and six interval counters: float article countdown x68, randomized effect countdown x70 and four fixed effect countdowns x74[0..3]. Article expiration requests HSD_Randi(4) + 0xC3; the effect counters request IDs 0x452 through 0x456. For effects 0x453–0x456, scale starts at 1 once per active invocation and each firing branch applies scale = (scale / 1.4) * item_scale, so simultaneous effects receive successively compounded scale values.

evidence.why: Separate position fields, trajectory construction and success guard.

facts.rationale: Corrects the asserted mouth-origin launch while retaining supported construction and success-only sound behavior.
facts.value: Constructs and requests one caller-selected Lizardon flame article. It places bone 0x32's world position in SpawnItem.prev_pos, obtains SpawnItem.pos separately from the parent's ECB-centered position helper, and derives planar launch velocity and facing from randomized attribute-controlled angle, speed and emission direction. Successful creation toggles sound parity and requests one of three random emission sounds on the enabled parity; failed creation leaves parity unchanged and requests no sound.

facts.value: Implements individual article requests during Charizard's Flamethrower attack, including caller-selected flame variant, attribute-controlled randomized trajectory, left/right emission direction and intermittent sound. The source distinguishes bone-derived previous position from ECB-derived current spawn position; it does not by itself establish the bone's visible identity or guarantee an upward trajectory.

evidence.why: Parent counter interpretation, cadence setup and command-controlled emission.
Spawn descriptor references and positions, followed by child attribute consumers.
Current spawn position helper implementation.

facts.rationale: Corrects the position-source ambiguity and preserves the materially different parent/child interpretations of x4 and cross-object reference flow.
facts.value: Parent attributes initialize attack counters and cadence fields, with parent x4 read through an s32 pointer for the repetition counter. Animation-command variables gate emission and toggle its direction. Child construction records bone 0x32's world position as prev_pos, obtains current pos separately through the ECB-position helper, and combines randomized kind selection with attribute-derived angle and speed. The descriptor carries the parent's owner and the parent actor as separate references. Each spawned variant then consumes its own scale and special attributes for effect setup and common initialization; its sole state separately ticks lifetime, multiplies velocity by child x4 as a float and delegates collision processing.
